subject.title: feat(google): add experimental Antigravity agy backend

question: After the sandbox defect is fixed, should OpenClaw officially bundle and enable by default this experimental Antigravity provider, or require it to mature as an externally maintained plugin first?
rationale: The public plugin seams already support the capability, VISION.md sets a high bar for optional bundled plugins, and a self-updating preview runtime creates ongoing compatibility and support ownership.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Publish and validate the provider from a dedicated repository before proposing official bundled promotion.

options.title: Sponsor bundled preview
options.body: Accept official ownership now, but require current-head live proof and an explicit supported-version and model-drift policy before merge.

recommendation.title: External plugin first
recommendation.body: Publish and validate the provider from a dedicated repository before proposing official bundled promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR assignment and recent adjacent provider-resolution work make this the strongest available routing signal for the decision.
